criteria.text: Diagnosis of WHO Group 1 pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH).
Patient is an adult, age 18 years or older (approval criterion 1).
Prescribed by or in consultation with a cardiologist or pulmonologist (approval criterion 2).
WHO Group 1 PAH confirmed by right heart catheterization (approval criterion 3).
WHO Functional Class II, III, or IV (approval criterion 4).

Currently receiving at least two PAH therapy classes, each for at least 60 days: PDE5 inhibitor, prostacyclin agent, endothelin receptor antagonist (ERA), or soluble guanylate cyclase (sGC) stimulator (approval criterion 5).
Prescriber attests patient is not pregnant and will not become pregnant during treatment (approval criterion 6).

notes: Partial encoding from Alaska Medicaid Winrevair (sotatercept-csrk) Criteria Version 1; Original 10/15/2024; Accepted 11/15/2024; Effective 01/01/2025.

Encoded: closed WHO Group 1 PAH indication and approval criteria 1-6. FDA adult age is represented as age >=18. Denial criterion 1 is failure to meet approval criteria. Pregnancy attestation includes a not-applicable male option.

Background therapy requires current treatment from at least two distinct classes, each for a minimum of 60 days: phosphodiesterase type 5 (PDE5) inhibitor, prostacyclin agent, endothelin receptor antagonist (ERA), or guanylate cyclase (sGC) stimulator. This is a single attestation; specific pairs are not separately required.

Cautions (notes only): serious bleeding may be more likely with concomitant prostacyclins and antithrombotics; erythrocytosis, sometimes severe; severe thrombocytopenia; male and female fertility may be impaired.
Duration (notes only): initial approval up to 3 months; reauthorization approval up to 1 year.
Quantity (notes only): 0.7 mg/kg injected subcutaneously every 3 weeks. max_units is null; quantity is not evaluated.
Documentation verification, cautions, duration, reauthorization and quantity require manual review; this pack remains partial.
